Full finite-state exact generator checked versus independent rational resolvent in 30 cases plus spectral cross-checks. Finite tests are not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: General Poisson-resetting stationary renewal and stochastic-functional moment methods are correctly attributed to Evans--Majumdar 2011 and Méndez et al. 2024/2025. The best-knowledge original claim is the sharp discrete-cycle threshold at four vertices, the all-parameter finite-cycle inequality V_n(r)<4/(r+4)^2, and sharp 3/2 asymptotic gain. Compared published mathematical records, relevant primary sources and prior mathematical claims; no implication covering all three sharp conclusions identified. Residual risks: an older equivalent exact cycle extremal theorem, broader renewal formulas whose specializations may imply parts, and abstract-only inspections of relevant graph/ring papers.

value.rationale: Origin-time fluctuations are a physically natural cumulative observable. The initial response reverses exactly at four sites despite strictly increasing stationary occupancy; the global upper envelope and sharp 50-percent asymptotic gain solve a nontrivial all-cycle fluctuation optimization problem. No downstream physical mixing/hitting-time claim or finite-optimizer uniqueness is asserted.
